findings.title: Login cache is not invalidated when an organization is enabled or disabled
findings.body: The getForLogin cache key is invalidated only in registerIDPLoginInvalidation and registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate, which are triggered by IDP create/update/remove. However, the login eligibility also depends on the organization's enabled state (enforced by the organization-aware wrapper added elsewhere). If an organization is disabled after the cache is populated, the cached login list still includes IDPs from that organization, potentially showing them on the login page or allowing them to be used for authentication by consumers that do not re-check isEnabled(). The cache should be invalidated when an organization's enabled state changes, but there is currently no mechanism to register such invalidation. This leads to stale, security-relevant data.

findings.title: Test cleanup uses literal "alias" instead of the actual alias variable
findings.body: In both testCacheIDPByOrg and testCacheIDPForLogin, the cleanup registration `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove);` passes the string "alias" instead of the loop variable `alias`. This means the created identity providers are not cleaned up after the test, leaving leftover data that can affect subsequent tests. It should be `testRealm().identityProviders().get(alias)::remove`.
